_meta.purpose: Atomic form blocks, authored to encode the DB UX layout guidelines directly (Spacing-Hierarchie, Gruppierung, Gestaltgesetze) for a focused single-column data-entry form. The recurring unit is a FIELD (a label-above control: Input / Select / Textarea) and a FIELDSET (a titled group of fields). Choice questions are RADIO/CHECKBOX groups; settings are SWITCH rows; agreements are CONSENT checkboxes. form/block-patterns.json composes these into intro / fieldset / actions.
_meta.vocabulary: Content-element names follow layout-guidelines.md → Contentarten: Headline/Title (fieldset heading), Label (a field's label), Meta/helper (a field's Infotext hint). Use these terms — do NOT invent synonyms.
_meta.spacingModel: A form has NO fixed base spacing of its own — it INHERITS R from the PRODUCT it lives in (a form is part of a product, and the product sets the density). ANCHORS: a form in a content/website product (public, e.g. bahn.de) inherits that product's R = lg (airy, comfortable, like contentpage); a form in an application / dashboard product (operational, internal) inherits R = md (compact, like dashboard); a very dense data-entry application inherits R = sm. LADDER (R-relative, applied identically at every R): (1) fields to each other WITHIN a fieldset, and card inner padding = R; (2) GROUPED bits — a fieldset title↔description, a field↔its helper Infotext, the options within one radio/checkbox group = R−1; (3) a fieldset's TITLE-BLOCK → its fields region = R+1; (4) fieldset ↔ fieldset, and the section header → the fieldset stack = R+2. RESOLUTION (token per role × product R): content/website product → R lg (grouped md, title→fields xl, groups/header 2xl); application/dashboard product → R md (grouped sm, title→fields lg, groups/header xl); dense data app → R sm (grouped xs, title→fields md, groups/header lg). The block fragments below are written at the R = md (application) REFERENCE; when the form's product is a content/website (R = lg) or a dense app (R = sm), substitute EVERY gap by the same role via this table BEFORE rendering. A field's OWN label↔control spacing is component-internal (the Input/Select renders it) and is NEVER set here. Never go tighter than R−1 for a grouped set (R−2 = the smallest step, reserved for a rare tight inline pair; the scale bottoms out at 2xs, already a valid container gap).
_meta.colorModel: Text emphasis follows screen-guidelines.md → Typografie: emphasis-100 (color.text.strong) is the DEFAULT — the fieldset Heading AND a radio/checkbox group's question label. A field's own label is rendered by the component. A helper Infotext / meta hint = color.text.muted (80). A form-level hint uses the Infotext component; an error/context summary uses a Notification tinted via semantic. Never Bold + muted.
_meta.authoringRule: Components (`type`/`props`) MUST resolve in components.json and tokens in tokens.json — structure/spacing come from the guidelines, components/tokens are never invented. A new block is allowed when existing ones do not cover the need, as long as it follows the spacingModel and resolves against the live registries.
_meta.componentNotes: Field label on Input/Select/Textarea: the label is HIDDEN by default (the '👁️ Show Label' boolean is false), so a label-above field MUST set BOTH applyProps { 'Show Label': true, 'Label': '<text>' } — setting only 'Label' leaves the label invisible. Required: add applyProps { 'Show Required Asterisk': true }; a non-required field sets it false (the default may show the asterisk). Checkbox/Radio/Switch option text: set via the `label` field (their single primary TEXT prop; no Show Label toggle). VARIANT CONSTRAINTS (components.json): Input/Select support label 'above'|'floating' — forms use 'above'; Textarea ships ONLY { label:'above', state:'filled' } (no empty variant — use it as-is, do not approximate); Switch ships ONLY { labelPosition:'trailing', width:'full', size:'small' } or { labelPosition:'leading', width:'full', size:'medium' } — and like Radio/Checkbox it also needs fillWidth:true on the node (the 'full' variant alone still hugs to ~115px and wraps the label); Checkbox/Radio use { size:'medium'|'small', width:'auto'|'full' } — a full-width stacked option uses width:'full' AND fillWidth:true on the node (the 'full' variant alone still lets the instance HUG to ~84px, wrapping the label character-by-character; fillWidth stretches the instance so the label gets the column width).
_meta.placeholderConvention: <...> = fill with real content; optional trailing '?' means the node may be dropped when empty. A '<a|b|c>' placeholder is a closed choice.
_meta.refConvention: { "$ref": "block.id" } expands to that block's `plan` fragment. The agent expands $ref when authoring the Composition Plan — the render runtime never sees $ref.

form.text-field.purpose: A single label-above text Input filling the form column. Add applyProps 'Show Required Asterisk' for required fields. For a format hint or error, group it with a helper Infotext at sm (R−1) inside a ContainerVertical; a bare field needs no wrapper.

form.select-field.purpose: A single label-above Select filling the form column — one value from a closed list. Prefer over a radio-group when the list is long or secondary.

form.textarea-field.purpose: A multi-line label-above Textarea filling the form column. NOTE: the DB Textarea ships ONLY the 'Label Above – Filled' variant (components.json), so it always renders in the filled style — set the Label and use it as-is; do NOT approximate an empty state or fake another variant.

form.field-row.purpose: Two SHORT related fields side by side (Vorname/Nachname, PLZ/Ort). A 50-50 Grid so both share the column width equally (layout-guidelines.md → aligned equal columns use a Grid, not hug/fill). Only for genuinely short peers — never a long field or a field+button.

form.radio-group.purpose: A single-choice question: a group label (Body bold, emphasis-100) above 2–5 stacked full-width Radios. The label↔options and the options among themselves are a grouped same-question set at sm (R−1). Exactly one option may be preselected via applyProps { 'Checked': 'True' }.

form.checkbox-group.purpose: A multi-select question: a group label (Body bold, emphasis-100) above independent full-width Checkboxes. Same sm (R−1) grouping as the radio-group.

form.switch-row.purpose: A single on/off setting as a full-width Switch (trailing label, small — the only trailing variant in components.json). One setting per row; stack several at md (fields to each other) inside a fieldset.

form.consent.purpose: A required agreement as a single full-width Checkbox whose label references the terms. Place near the end, before the action row. Keep the interactive element single (Checkbox) — if the terms need a link, the label wording carries it (a clickable-card-style nested Link inside the checkbox is not built here).

plan.label: <Ich akzeptiere die AGB und die Datenschutzerklärung.>

form.info.purpose: A form-level hint (neutral) as an Infotext, OR an error/context summary as a Notification. The Infotext carries a short convention line ('Pflichtfelder sind mit * markiert'); the Notification (tinted via semantic) summarizes errors/important context. Placed at the top of the intro or the affected fieldset — never as its own section. Notification text props are `headline` + `text` (NOT description).

form.fieldset.purpose: A titled group of related fields: a title-block (Heading h2 + optional description at sm, R−1) above a fields region (ContainerVertical, gap md — fields to each other). The title-block → fields gap is lg (R+1). This is the core repeatable form group; stack several at xl (fieldset ↔ fieldset).

form.actions.purpose: The closing action row: the primary submit (Brand, ≤1 per page) plus an optional secondary (ghost/outlined) cancel/back. A hug ContainerHorizontal (buttons size to their labels) as a same-kind action group at sm (R−2 relative to a content page; here sm keeps the pair tight). Brand primary first, secondary after.
